notices: Cancelled: Rayo Vallecano v Athletic Bilbao (listed for 09 Dec). It is still simulated as a match to be played (assumption: cancelled matches are almost always replayed). Any locked prediction for it is voided and not scored. If it is scrapped or awarded instead, it goes into configs/awarded_results.yaml.

run.seed_rule: first 4 bytes of sha256('<run date, UTC, YYYY-MM-DD>|<competition id>'), big-endian

model.strength_uncertainty: each simulated season draws its ratings from the fit's uncertainty
model.match_predictions: best-estimate ratings (the season simulations also draw rating uncertainty)
